briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models in May with accelerating capability jumps. Regulatory momentum builds but lags deployment speed. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; xAI launched Grok-3. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta Llama 4 open weights followed within days. Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 achieved new multimodal benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Multiple red-team reports exposed persistent injection vectors in agentic systems. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra ramp; Microsoft and Google each broke ground on 5GW AI campuses. TSMC reports 3nm yield issues delaying 2026 capacity.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI-level system emerge from a closed lab or open-weight ecosystem by 2028?
